strategy.method: Keep a genuinely pre-propositional reserve of two or three incomplete pressures while exposing only one to the writer at a time. Compose into a provisional burst buffer without sentence-level conceptual review; keep critic history and the numerical minimum outside the writer. After provisional sentence boundaries, a separate contrastive attention scheduler checks only whether the newest pair are substantially interchangeable realizations of one proposition. If so, it temporarily masks that semantic center and exposes a peripheral literal pressure or dormant pre-propositional reserve item without revealing the diagnosis or consulting source coverage. The length controller independently returns only CONTINUE or STOP. STOP freezes the whole buffer for critic review. Reconcile source obligations only after a live passage exists.
